title: American Graffiti
about: On the last night of summer in 1962, four friends cruise the Modesto strip before two of them leave for college in the morning.
cue: Serve the chilli dogs when the Wolfman reads Curt's message on the air.
faces: The blonde in the white T-bird

MODESTO, CALIFORNIA. LAST NIGHT OF SUMMER
Vic offers Toad a knuckle sandwich. Pulled ham hock on soft rolls with mustard slaw.
The drag race out on Paradise Road. Crunchy fries under beef chilli with cheddar.
Onion rings for the whole car
The Wolfman is everywhere tonight. Grilled franks under beef chilli with raw onion.
Toad's waiting on a double Chubby Chuck. Two smashed patties with American cheese and pickles.
A white '56 cruising Third Street. Vanilla ice cream under hot fudge with malted crumbs.
Toad lost his ID in a flood. Kentucky bourbon and Coca-Cola over ice.

Pulled ham hock on soft rolls with mustard slaw.How to make it2 smoked ham hocks1 brown onion, halved2 bay leaves3 tbsp smoky barbecue sauce8 soft slider rolls1/4 white cabbage, finely shredded2 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp American mustard1 tbsp cider vinegarCover the hocks, onion and bay leaves with water and simmer until the meat falls from the bone.Pull the meat into shreds, discarding skin and bone, and toss with the barbecue sauce and a splash of the liquid.Mix the cabbage with the mayo, mustard and vinegar.Pile the ham into the rolls, top with slaw and serve warm.Paradise Road chilli cheese friesThe drag race out on Paradise Road. Crunchy fries under beef chilli with cheddar.How to make it1kg frozen thick-cut fries400g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin400g tin crushed tomatoes150g cheddar, grated2 spring onions, slicedBrown the mince with the onion, then add the spices and tomatoes and simmer until thick.Bake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Pile the fries on a tray, spoon over the chilli and scatter with cheese.Flash under a hot grill until melted and top with spring onion.Onion rings for the whole carWhere were you in '62?How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.From the KitchenWolfman's midnight chilli dogsThe Wolfman is everywhere tonight. Two smashed patties with American cheese and pickles.How to make it800g beef mince, 20 percent fat8 slices of American cheese4 soft burger buns1 brown onion, very finely sliced1/2 cup dill pickle slices4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp American mustard4 iceberg lettuce leavesRoll the mince into 8 balls and season well.Smash each ball flat onto a very hot greased pan with a sturdy spatula and cook until crusty.Flip, top with cheese and onion and cook another minute.Mix the mayo, tomato sauce and mustard and spread on the toasted buns.Stack two patties per bun with lettuce and pickles.SweetsWhite '56 T-bird vanilla malt sundaeA white '56 cruising Third Street.
